name: CMOS 2-Input NOR Gate
description: Static CMOS 2-input NOR gate. Pull-up network: two series PMOS devices (M_PU1, M_PU2) — output HIGH only when both inputs are LOW. Pull-down network: two parallel NMOS devices (M_ND1, M_ND2) — output LOW when either input is HIGH. Note: the series PMOS stack requires wider PMOS to compensate for lower hole mobility, making NOR larger than NAND in CMOS.

High Speed.reasoning: Series PMOS sized 3x single PMOS width to overcome both hole mobility and stacking penalty.

Low Power.reasoning: Longer channels for leakage reduction; PMOS still oversized to maintain logic margin.

default.reasoning: Series PMOS W = 2x single PMOS (accounts for hole mobility ratio ~2) for balanced t_pHL / t_pLH.

sizing_notes.M_PU1: Series pull-up PMOS — top of stack; wider than single PMOS to overcome hole mobility + stacking.
sizing_notes.M_PU2: Series pull-up PMOS — bottom of stack; body terminal connected to VDD to avoid forward-biased junction issues.
sizing_notes.M_ND1: Parallel pull-down NMOS — for input A; no stacking penalty, standard width.
sizing_notes.M_ND2: Parallel pull-down NMOS — for input B.
